tiktok-insanefindz.author: Adonis 🇨🇺
tiktok-insanefindz.text: @Milianna🃏🐆🍸: @taylor fan: LET'S SPREAD THE GOSPEL (Psalm 23:4) it says, even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me." This reminds us that even in the darkest and most challenging times, God is with us, and He is our comfort and our guide. As it's written in (Romans 8:38-39) "For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord." This verse assures us that nothing can separate us from God's love, and that He is always with us, no matter what we're going through. IN JESUS NAME WE SAY?
